question: How much of the flower-cap photographic failure is due to cap fragments versus the gold ribbon occluding a simpler regular weave?
annotationBasis: Visual inspection of the already fixed 400-pixel RGB crop, before any diagnostic fitting. The coarse caps region and ribbon polygons indicate uncertainty, not observed hidden paper identity or ground-truth overlap corners.

caps.meaning: Coarse diagnostic removal of upper/left lobe intrusions; also removes valid border evidence, so cannot certify a better crop.

sourceInvariant: Every arm keeps exactly the same mask and crop. Zero observation weights only in the declared diagnostic regions; no inpainting, threshold changes or solver-driven crop movement.
evaluation: Independently render every exported curve pair at the prepared resolution.
Report protected error and coverage as well as disagreement with ALL original classified pixels, source features and geometry/paper status.
Do not count a weighted/protected success as success on the original photograph.
Inspect all four overlays and preserve every failure.
A second exact-geometry control will distinguish available hidden-image inference from a merely lower observed error; no exact geometry is supplied to fitting.
regularConstructionQualification: The visible gold ribbon is an added decoration/occluder, not a third material the existing two-sheet mask can model. Whether the actual flat cutting template uses exactly two cuts remains an inference to test, not supplied truth.
execution: Wait for current full repository QA to finish; no concurrent fitting jobs. No application changes or learned-model training in this diagnostic.

syntheticControl.construction: Exactly straight equal-width grid, two cuts per sheet, phase +1, at 400 pixels. Paint the declared ribbon polygons as material value 1 without changing the latent clean mask.
syntheticControl.arms: The same four observation-weight arms as the photograph. The cap exclusion is an irrelevant-region control here; no cap corruption is added.
syntheticControl.role: Known-mask counterfactual, not a photorealistic training sample; hidden reference pixels and cut counts never enter fitting or selection.
syntheticControl.score: Report disagreement with the known clean grid independently of observed-region fit, while still retaining disagreement with the corrupted input.

annotationVisualReview.finding: Cyan polygons cover the visible gold strips and a conservative fringe. Magenta limits discard the top and left decorative-cap intrusions, together with valid border pixels. These are manually supplied diagnostic regions, not an automatic detector.

routingQualification: Observation weights use the existing weighted direct-fitting path. The unweighted arm may also try MILP; differences include the pipeline response to uncertainty, not only an isolated loss gradient.
